scheduling_policy: One solver per physical GPU. The AMD wrapper checks the single exposed Vulkan vendor and checks the native context name before dispatch. Isolated process driver manifest; NVIDIA fine run continues on its original adapter. Separate adapter leases permit overlap across physical devices only.
